title: The Town and Country Planning (Fees for Applications, Deemed Applications, Requests and Site Visits) (England) (Amendment and Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Town and Country Planning (Fees for Applications, Deemed Applications, Requests and Site Visits) (England) Regulations 2012 (S.I. 2012/2920) (“the 2012 Regulations”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Helicopter Flight) (No. 10) Regulations 2026
The Service and Administration Charges (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision about service charges and administration charges in relation to leases of dwellings in England.

title: The Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003 Remedial Order 2026
The Scotland Act 1998 (Agency Arrangements) (Specification) (Digital Waste Tracking) Order 2026
summary: This Order paves the way for the Scottish Ministers and a Minister of the Crown to enter into agency arrangements, under which a Minister of the Crown can exercise certain functions of the designated person acting under, or in accordance with, any regulations made under section 34CA of the Environmental Protection Act 1990. Any such arrangements would be agreed between Ministers of the Crown and the Scottish Ministers.

title: The Secretaries of State for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade and for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport and the Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster Order 2026
summary: This Order in Council is made under sections 1 and 2 of the Ministers of the Crown Act 1975 (c. 26).

title: The Collective Investment Schemes (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make an amendment to the Collective Investment Schemes (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/325) (“CIS Regulations”), regarding temporary recognition for the purposes of Part 17 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (c. 8).

title: The Building Insurance Information (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision regarding information about insurance that a landlord must give to a tenant where a service charge includes an amount payable for that insurance. They concern leases of dwellings in England.

title: The Feed-in Tariffs (Amendment) (British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme Excluded Electricity) Order 2026
summary: This Order is made in exercise of the powers in sections 43(3)(a) and 104(2) of the Energy Act 2008 (c. 32). It amends the Feed-in Tariffs Order 2012 (S.I. 2012/2782) to make amendments as to how annual levelisation payments are calculated under article 27 of that Order. In particular, this Order introduces an exemption from that calculation for electricity supplied to customers operating in certain manufacturing sectors, under the British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme.

title: The Maximum Number of Judges (Scotland) Order 2026
summary: Article 2 of this Order amends section 1(1) of the Court of Session Act 1988 so as to increase the maximum number of persons who may be appointed as judges of the Court of Session from 36 to 40. Article 3 revokes the Maximum Number of Judges (Scotland) Order 2022 which had previously increased the maximum number of judges of the Court of Session to 36.

title: The Radio Selection Services (Designation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations designate a number of radio selection services for the purposes of Part 3B of the Communications Act 2023 (c. 21) (regulation of radio selection services).

title: The A92/A972 Trunk Road (Dundee) (Temporary 30mph and 40mph Speed Restrictions) Order 2026
The Children (Care and Justice) (Scotland) Act 2024 (Commencement No. 4) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force various provisions of the Children (Care and Justice) (Scotland) Act 2024 (“the Act”).

title: The Victims, Witnesses, and Justice Reform (Scotland) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force certain provisions of the Victims, Witnesses, and Justice Reform (Scotland) Act 2025 (“the Act”).

summary: These Regulations amend the Marine Licensing (Exempted Activities) Order 2011 (S.I. 2011/409) (“the 2011 Order”) and the Marine Licensing (Application Fees) Regulations 2014 (S.I. 2014/615) (“the Fees Regulations”).

title: The Withdrawal Agreement (Windsor Framework and Governance) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulation 2(6) omits section 15C of the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018 to allow the United Kingdom co-chair to consent to the Joint Committee adopting decisions or recommendations by written procedure for the period in between meetings, provided for in Rule 9(1) of Annex VIII of the Withdrawal Agreement.

title: The Renewables Obligation (Scotland) Amendment (No. 2) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Renewables Obligation (Scotland) Order 2009 (“the 2009 Order”).
